Pharma Stocks Surge, Reaching New Peaks Amid Market Gains

Several pharmaceutical stocks, including Lupin and Torrent, have reached new record highs, while Sun Pharma is nearing its summit. This surge in pharma stocks coincides with a broader rise in the stock market, with the Sensex gaining 500 points. Other companies like Airtel, Nestle, and Jio Financial also saw notable share price increases.
